vuln_statements.explanation: This statement allocates memory via skb_put() using sockaddr_size without proper validation. If sockaddr_size contains an attacker-controlled value that causes integer overflow or exceeds expected bounds, it can lead to buffer overflow when writing to the allocated skb structure.

This statement sets the message length field using a size variable that may contain user-controlled values. Without proper validation, integer overflow in size calculation could result in incorrect message length being reported, leading to buffer overflows during subsequent operations.

This code performs insufficient validation of address length fields. An improperly validated prefixlen field could allow crafted packets to trigger kernel bugs or cause memory corruption through insufficient bounds checking before the BUG() is reached.
